# Munder Difflin

> Munder Difflin gives you clones for you and your team, working 24/7. It is a free,
> MIT-licensed, local-first multi-agent harness for CLI coding agents that turns Claude Code,
> OpenAI Codex, Antigravity (Gemini), GitHub Copilot CLI, xAI Grok, Kimi Code, Qwen, OpenCode,
> Crush, Gemini CLI, Cursor Agent, and pi.dev into a coordinated "office" of agents on
> your own computer — each agent a real CLI process in a real terminal, with shared
> long-term memory, inter-agent messaging, your clone ("Michael") orchestrating, scheduled missions, Slack
> and webhook triggers, realtime voice orchestration, a built-in Monaco IDE with git
> history and branch compare, markdown previews, and auto-update. The interface runs in
> English, Simplified Chinese and Arabic, with right to left layout when Arabic is chosen,
> and its fonts are bundled rather than fetched from a font host. Current version: 0.4.6
> (August 2026). Desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux. No vendor cloud; code never
> leaves your machine. It covers the same jobs as YC's qm (security postures, background
> crons/watches, Slack, shared skills) as a simpler local-first desktop app, and adds what
> a headless harness doesn't have: watchable terminals, voice, an IDE, auto-update.
